snippet.title: Sketchbook Squad release mini-trailer (6seconds)
snippet.description:
Sketchbook Squad is our Summer 2013 freebie game!

Get the details and available versions here:
http://orangepixel.net/sketchbooksquad

Jump your way to the top in this funky Sketchbook squad minigame! This new group of heroes will get some more games from us in the near future, for now you can enjoy this free game and pass some time!


Follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Google+ to stay up to date on our games:
